defmodule CloudSDK.AccessControl do
  @moduledoc """
  Role-based access control for cloud infrastructure operations.
  Handles permission checks with graceful shutdown support.
  """

  use GenServer
  require Logger

  defstruct [
    :role_cache,
    :pending_operations,
    :shutdown_state,
    :auth_provider,
    :operation_log
  ]

  @roles %{
    admin: [:read, :write, :delete, :manage_roles, :shutdown],
    operator: [:read, :write, :delete],
    viewer: [:read],
    service_account: [:read, :write]
  }

  @shutdown_grace_period_ms 5000

  def start_link(opts) do
    GenServer.start_link(__MODULE__, opts, name: __MODULE__)
  end

  def init(opts) do
    auth_provider = Keyword.get(opts, :auth_provider, CloudSDK.DefaultAuth)
    
    # Register signal handlers for graceful shutdown
    :os.set_signal(:sigterm, :handle)
    :os.set_signal(:sigint, :handle)
    
    state = %__MODULE__{
      role_cache: %{},
      pending_operations: :queue.new(),
      shutdown_state: :running,
      auth_provider: auth_provider,
      operation_log: []
    }

    {:ok, state}
  end

  def authorize_operation(user_id, operation, resource) do
    GenServer.call(__MODULE__, {:authorize, user_id, operation, resource})
  end

  def initiate_shutdown(requester_id) do
    GenServer.cast(__MODULE__, {:shutdown_request, requester_id})
  end

  def get_pending_operations do
    GenServer.call(__MODULE__, :get_pending)
  end

  # Handle OS signals - transitions to draining state
  def handle_info({:signal, _sig}, state) do
    Logger.info("Received shutdown signal, entering drain mode")
    new_state = %{state | shutdown_state: :draining}
    Process.send_after(self(), :force_shutdown, @shutdown_grace_period_ms)
    {:noreply, new_state}
  end

  def handle_info(:force_shutdown, state) do
    Logger.warn("Grace period expired, forcing shutdown")
    drain_pending_operations(state)
    {:stop, :normal, state}
  end

  def handle_info(_msg, state), do: {:noreply, state}

  # Authorization check - the core RBAC logic
  def handle_call({:authorize, user_id, operation, resource}, _from, state) do
    case check_permission(user_id, operation, state) do
      {:ok, :permitted} ->
        new_state = enqueue_operation(state, user_id, operation, resource)
        {:reply, {:ok, :authorized}, new_state}

      {:error, reason} ->
        {:reply, {:error, reason}, state}
    end
  end

  def handle_call(:get_pending, _from, state) do
    {:reply, {:ok, :queue.to_list(state.pending_operations)}, state}
  end

  # Shutdown request via cast - checks role
  def handle_cast({:shutdown_request, requester_id}, state) do
    case resolve_role(requester_id, state) do
      {:ok, role} when role in [:admin] ->
        Logger.info("Admin #{requester_id} initiated shutdown")
        new_state = %{state | shutdown_state: :draining}
        Process.send_after(self(), :force_shutdown, @shutdown_grace_period_ms)
        {:noreply, new_state}

      _ ->
        Logger.warn("Unauthorized shutdown attempt by #{requester_id}")
        {:noreply, state}
    end
  end

  # Permission check considers shutdown state
  defp check_permission(user_id, operation, state) do
    with {:ok, role} <- resolve_role(user_id, state),
         :ok <- verify_operation_allowed(role, operation),
         :ok <- check_shutdown_constraints(operation, state) do
      {:ok, :permitted}
    end
  end

  defp resolve_role(user_id, state) do
    case Map.get(state.role_cache, user_id) do
      nil ->
        # Fetch from auth provider and cache
        case state.auth_provider.get_role(user_id) do
          {:ok, role} -> {:ok, role}
          error -> error
        end

      cached_role ->
        {:ok, cached_role}
    end
  end

  defp verify_operation_allowed(role, operation) do
    permissions = Map.get(@roles, role, [])

    if operation in permissions do
      :ok
    else
      {:error, :insufficient_permissions}
    end
  end

  # During drain, write operations are rejected
  defp check_shutdown_constraints(operation, state) do
    case {state.shutdown_state, operation} do
      {:draining, op} when op in [:write, :delete, :manage_roles] ->
        {:error, :system_shutting_down}

      {:running, _} ->
        :ok

      # During draining, reads are still allowed
      {:draining, :read} ->
        :ok

      _ ->
        {:error, :unknown_state}
    end
  end

  defp enqueue_operation(state, user_id, operation, resource) do
    entry = %{
      user_id: user_id,
      operation: operation,
      resource: resource,
      timestamp: System.monotonic_time(:millisecond),
      state_at_enqueue: state.shutdown_state
    }

    new_queue = :queue.in(entry, state.pending_operations)
    %{state | pending_operations: new_queue}
  end

  defp drain_pending_operations(state) do
    ops = :queue.to_list(state.pending_operations)
    # Re-validate each operation before execution during shutdown
    Enum.each(ops, fn op ->
      case check_operation_still_valid(op, state) do
        :ok -> execute_operation(op)
        {:error, reason} ->
          Logger.warn("Dropping operation #{op.operation} for #{op.user_id}: #{reason}")
      end
    end)
  end

  defp check_operation_still_valid(op, state) do
    with {:ok, role} <- resolve_role(op.user_id, state),
         :ok <- verify_operation_allowed(role, op.operation) do
      # During forced shutdown, only allow reads to complete
      if op.operation == :read do
        :ok
      else
        {:error, :rejected_during_shutdown}
      end
    end
  end

  defp execute_operation(op) do
    Logger.info("Executing #{op.operation} on #{op.resource} for #{op.user_id}")
    # Actual cloud API call would go here
    :ok
  end
end

defmodule CloudSDK.DefaultAuth do
  def get_role("admin_" <> _), do: {:ok, :admin}
  def get_role("op_" <> _), do: {:ok, :operator}
  def get_role("svc_" <> _), do: {:ok, :service_account}
  def get_role(_), do: {:ok, :viewer}
end
